if_you_cut_one_page: Page 2: series branding that delays the story and reads as promotion; the book works without it at that point.
notes: Every Band line is a team note and is marked cut as the reader would not see it. The pages with the most dramatised speech and least context (5, 6, 8) are where a sceptic loses the thread; the record is promised online but not on the page. Page 9's Web Summit plug and page 10's zoom signpost should be neutral and short. Passage 'Why' should be read as the footnote on page 7.
